headline: How UHS’s New US$700 Million Short-Term Loan and Dividend Move Has Changed Its Investment Story
summary: Universal Health Services, Inc. recently amended its long-standing credit agreement to add a delayed-draw senior secured term loan facility of up to US$700 million, maturing 364 days after funding and intended for general corporate purposes, including refinancing existing debt, while also reaffirming a US$0.20 per-share cash dividend payable on September 15, 2026. This combination of added short-term borrowing capacity, tied to leverage-based pricing, and continued dividend payments...
